# F7: Fit and finish, data-workspace

A check of the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/7-data-workspace.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

fit and finish, data-workspace (per-area reports, 4 Nov). [Dn] are the Data tables report's findings, [Wn] the Workspace and set-up report's.

## Where it looks

- 360 × 740, as grace, at `/data`
- 1280 × 800, as rhea, at `/data`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
